requirements: R1: The machine starts in Idle.
R2: Inserting a coin in Idle moves to CreditAvailable.
R3: Pressing coffee in CreditAvailable moves to Dispensing.
R4: Pressing coffee in Idle must be ignored (no state change).
R5: Dispense complete in Dispensing returns to Idle.
R6: The machine returns to Idle after a successful dispense cycle.
